name: The Wounds of Betrayal

angles.text: As a druid, you know the weight of seeing fellow caretakers of the wilds suffer betrayal and grievous injury. The shen'dorei druids are few.
As a night elf, you revere druidic traditions. The suffering of kindred druids in Shadowgale Forest and their struggle against treachery may weigh heavily on you.

aliases: who gives the wounds of betrayal
quest giver the wounds of betrayal
faq.answer: Elegael, a shen'dorei druid, asks you to tend her wounded brethren after a violent attack in Shadowgale Forest.
faq.q: Who gives the quest The Wounds of Betrayal?

faq.answer: Nightfang Den lies north across the clearing in Shadowgale Forest. Injured shen'dorei druids have taken refuge in the cave.
Jorel Windsinger is Elegael's mate. Badly injured in the attack, he remained in Nightfang Den, where you learn his fate.
The shen'dorei are a rare people with few druids among them. Elegael says every survivor is precious.

aliases: why does elegael hate al aketh
faq.answer: The Al'Aketh are enemies responsible for the attack on the druids, or allies of those responsible. After learning Jorel's fate and seeing the devastation, Elegael vows vengeance on them and anyone allied with them.

When you find Jorel Windsinger in Nightfang Den, his condition has taken a tragic turn. News of his fate and the surviving druids' dire state leaves Elegael grief-stricken and furious, and she vows revenge.
faq.q: What happens to Jorel Windsinger in the quest?

sections.body: Elegael tends the shen'dorei druids hurt in the assault on Shadowgale Forest. She has prepared poultices for her brethren sheltering in Nightfang Den, just north across the clearing. Few shen'dorei druids remain, and every survivor matters to their fragile enclave.
sections.title: Aid for the Shen'dorei

sections.body: Elegael asks you to find her mate, Jorel Windsinger, and bring care to the seven battered druids in the cave. When she fled the fighting to prepare medicines, Jorel was already clinging to life. Nightfang Den holds the full devastation wrought upon the sanctuary, and Jorel's fate lies in its dark recesses.
sections.title: The Search for Jorel Windsinger

sections.body: After learning Jorel's end and seeing the terrible toll on her brethren, Elegael's grief turns to fury. She casts off despair and chooses retribution. Anyone allied with the Al'Aketh will face her unrelenting wrath for the slaughter of her people.
sections.title: A Vow of Retribution

summary: In Shadowgale Forest, Elegael cares for the shen'dorei druids wounded in a terrible assault. Poultices are ready for Nightfang Den, north across the clearing, while her mate Jorel Windsinger is missing.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Wounds of Betrayal
